Three of the 12 mention arbitration:

- Acme_MSA.pdf, §14.2
- Brightline_SOW.docx, §9
- Northwind_NDA.pdf, §11

Eight other files were searched and have no mention. The twelfth, Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf, is a scanned image with no extractable text, so I couldn't search it and can't say whether it has an arbitration clause. It needs OCR or a manual read to rule out.
